newsitem.title: JAPAN: NISSAN MAY FORM VENTURE WITH INDONESIA SALIM GROUP.
newsitem.headline: NISSAN MAY FORM VENTURE WITH INDONESIA SALIM GROUP.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Friday it was considering setting up a joint venture with Indonesia's Salim Group.
Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun has reported that the two will produce gas engines starting in 2000 with a total investment of 10 billion yen.
"We are considering doing business with the Salim Group in Indonesia eventually, but we have not yet decided on any of the details," a Nissan spokesman said.
The spokesman declined to comment further.
The venture is expected to build a plant with production capacity of 10,000 units, the paper said.
